principle.name: SUPPORT MAY MIGRATE ACROSS THE BODY WITHOUT ROOT TRAVEL GOING FREE
principle.summary: A grounded roll is authored as a moving support manifold: foot load hands off into forearm/arm/back/hip and only later rebinds to a foot. Root travel continues, but each support owner must be trustworthy before the next rise or direction change.
principle.novelty: first locomotion specimen whose trusted support owner migrates from feet onto non-foot body contacts while root travel remains continuously grounded
